records.name: 设备、端子与连接点
records.summary: Keep Equipment, ConductingEquipment, Terminal and ConnectivityNode identities distinct. In the selected CGMES3 profile, a Terminal belongs to exactly one ConductingEquipment and has zero or one ConnectivityNode association; a connectivity relation alone does not prove energization. Preserve model-authority/exchange scope for mRID.
records.standard_gap: 所选公开CGMES3配置支持逐类语义与该配置基数；本地节点版本化、source键映射及停电影响推导仍为非标准建模。未取得付费IEC完整正文，不能据公开配置宣称完整IEC或CGMES交换符合性。

standard_basis.scope: CIM共享资源类、属性和关系的总体模型范围；没有读取逐类条款。

standard_basis.locator: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/entsoe/application-profiles-library/8eff738bda72dc3a97fc24bf021dc78773814111/CGMES/RDFS/61970-600-2_Equipment-AP-Voc-RDFS2020.rdf; cim:Equipment, ConductingEquipment, Terminal, ConnectivityNode, Terminal.ConductingEquipment, Terminal.ConnectivityNode, IdentifiedObject.mRID
standard_basis.scope: 设备/导电设备/端子/零阻抗连接点分离，mRID由模型权威分配且在交换上下文唯一；cim=http://iec.ch/TC57/CIM100#。
所选配置端子到设备min1/max1、端子到连接点max1；不规定本地业务图所有边的通用基数。

records.name: 拓扑版本
records.summary: TopologicalNode represents topology under a network state; its connectivity-node membership can depend on switch state, while planning bus models have a distinct modeling context. Locally select one compatible snapshot for event_time and knowledge_cutoff, retaining source identities and intervals.
records.standard_gap: TopologicalNode及源模型头的有界语义已由公开配置核实；event_time/knowledge_cutoff筛选、兼容性判定、原始键映射和有效区间为非标准建模，未运行CGMES数据集全约束校验。

standard_basis.scope: 交换配置及其模型/版本依赖的背景。
状态相关的拓扑节点/连接点关联与规划母线语境分离。
源模型代表时点与版本特定依赖有独立身份；md=http://iec.ch/TC57/61970-552/ModelDescription/1#。

records.name: 开关状态观测
records.summary: In CGMES3, Switch.open is topology-processing input and Switch.normalOpen is used when no status measurement is present. The Switch definition excludes ACDCTerminal.connected at either side as the switch-connectivity test; consider open, normalOpen and locked. Locally retain closed/open/unknown, event validity, observed_at and evidence without treating defaults as observations.
records.standard_gap: 公开配置核实了Switch字段语义及Boolean基数；unknown/冲突传播、event_time/observed_at和实际状态证据选择仍为非标准建模。未读取付费IEC完整Switch条款；输入拓扑状态不等于现场观测或安全操作结论。

standard_basis.scope: normalOpen与无状态测量场景及Switch连通性边界；端子connected不得代替开关自身状态。
开关拓扑输入、闭锁和端子连接状态是不同字段。
所选EQ配置normalOpen为Boolean且min1/max1。
所选SSH配置open和locked为Boolean且min1/max1；三值unknown是项目扩展。

records.name: 电源与分布式电源
records.summary: Keep EnergySource, power-electronics network connection and Equipment.inService availability distinct. Available-source reachability is only the local candidate test; unknown DER availability or tie/backfeed paths create local uncertainty. Capacity, protection, phase and islanding require separate study.
records.standard_gap: 公开配置仅支持电源等值、电子电力连接及设备可用性字段；反送电候选、未知传播与本地DER策略为非标准建模，未核实潮流、保护、孤岛或安全送电标准。

standard_basis.scope: 供能等值与采用电力电子的交流网络连接分离；不推定DER实际出力。
设备可用于拓扑处理的状态，不等于已带电或具备安全供电能力。

records.name: 供电点、客户与回路
records.summary: Service points are physical connection scope; customers can own several points and circuit assignment can change. Customer counting follows valid bindings, not point count.
records.standard_gap: 未从已取得CGMES3配置建立Customer/UsagePoint/回路与本地供电点的精确类映射或基数；全部客户绑定、计数和时间规则为非标准建模。EnergyConsumer消费模型点不得自动等同客户身份，付费IEC对应详情仍为标准未核实。

standard_basis.scope: CIM共享资源类、属性和关系的总体模型范围；没有读取逐类条款。

records.name: 计划与实际停电
records.summary: A planned removal is a scenario input. Actual interruption needs observed evidence; neither reachability nor a work order proves a customer interruption.
records.standard_gap: 计划移除、客户实际停电认定和证据门槛均为非标准建模；已取得公开CGMES配置未规定本例客户中断认定。

records.name: 恢复分段
records.summary: Keep per-service-point interruption segments with event intervals and observation evidence; union overlaps before duration totals and preserve repeat interruptions.
records.standard_gap: 分段中断、交叠区间并集和重复中断保留均为非标准建模；未取得适用的供电可靠性考核标准。

records.name: 电气量与边界
records.summary: Retain value, coded unit/multiplier, phase/reference context, event time and evidence. CGMES3 separates PhaseCode and Terminal.phases; the phase enumeration alone does not describe phase interconnection or grounding. Do not infer safe switching or electrical feasibility from a topological path.
records.standard_gap: 公开配置支持相位、单位与倍率的概念分离；本地数值/时间证据字段、换算政策及拓扑可达安全边界为非标准建模，未完成电气可行性或安全标准核实。

standard_basis.scope: 相位语境、单位和倍率分别表达；PhaseCode本身不编码相间连接或接地方式。

records.name: CIM 与交换配置范围
records.summary: IEC catalogue metadata identifies the base and amendment; acquired ENTSO-E CGMES3 RDFS/SHACL artifacts now ground the specifically cited classes, fields and profile constraints. These public artifacts are distinct from complete paid IEC text. Local outage nodes, projections and three-valued decisions remain original project choices.
records.standard_gap: 仅已取得的公开配置字段和约束具有所列标准依据；付费IEC完整条款仍为标准未核实。本地图schema、停电投影和三值决策为非标准建模，未宣称完整CGMES交换或接口认证。

standard_basis.scope: IEC61970CIM17v38、2020-01-21及基础标准范围。
AMD1版本身份；未读取详细修订条款。
交换配置、依赖和发布导航。

records.name: 模型、配置与快照清单
records.summary: Keep CIM model version, CGMES profile version, model document identity, boundary/reference dataset and local study snapshot separately. In the acquired Header profile, Model.created is serialization time and Model.scenarioTime is represented model-valid time; version, profile, DependentOn and Supersedes retain source identity. Neither clock is local observed_at. Independently versioned NCP labels do not rename CGMES3.

standard_basis.scope: 官方库区分CIM、CGMES、Network Code Profiles及边界资料的发布身份。

created/scenarioTime/version为min1/max1；profile至少1；类型分别dateTime/dateTime/integer/anyURI，只覆盖所列Header约束。
